# Ripple

Concentric water ripples, or a shockwave ring that expands and fades, spreading from a point. The waves bend the image radially and can catch the light.

<EffectDemo effect="ripple" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { ripple } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/ripple';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(ripple({ preset: 'pond' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.mode = 'ripple'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type                    | Default      | Range       | Description                                                                                                    |
| ------------ | ----------------------- | ------------ | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mode`       | 'ripple' \| 'shockwave' | `'ripple'`   |             | Continuous waves, or one ring that repeats.                                                                    |
| `center`     | [x, y]                  | `[0.5, 0.5]` | 0 – 1       | Origin of the waves, in UV coordinates.                                                                        |
| `amplitude`  | number                  | `0.02`       | 0 – 0.1     | Largest displacement, as a fraction of the height.                                                             |
| `wavelength` | number                  | `0.08`       | 0.01 – 0.5  | Distance between crests, or the width of the shockwave ring, as a fraction of the height.                      |
| `speed`      | number                  | `0.15`       | 0 – 2       | How fast the waves travel outwards, in heights per second.                                                     |
| `decay`      | number                  | `1.5`        | 0 – 10      | How quickly the waves weaken with distance (ripple) or as the ring grows (shockwave).                          |
| `interval`   | number                  | `2`          | 0.25 – 10 s | Shockwave: time between rings.                                                                                 |
| `phase`      | number                  | `0.3`        | 0 – 1       | Shockwave: how far through its cycle the ring is at time zero; with motion off this fixes where the ring sits. |
| `shading`    | number                  | `0.4`        | 0 – 1       | Brightens the wave faces that tilt toward the viewer.                                                          |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                                                                                                              |
| ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pond`      | `amplitude: 0.01`, `wavelength: 0.05`, `decay: 3`                                                                     |
| `swell`     | `amplitude: 0.025`, `wavelength: 0.2`, `speed: 0.08`, `decay: 1`                                                      |
| `shockwave` | `mode: 'shockwave'`, `amplitude: 0.06`, `wavelength: 0.08`, `speed: 0.6`, `decay: 1`, `interval: 1.6`, `shading: 0.6` |
| `pulse`     | `mode: 'shockwave'`, `amplitude: 0.015`, `wavelength: 0.12`, `speed: 0.3`, `interval: 3`, `shading: 0.6`              |

Apply one with `ripple({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Distortion & warp · tracked as story X9.1 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Freezes: when motion is off (reduced motion, high contrast or `composer.motion = false`) the effect holds its current frame.
- **Size:** 5.4 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/ripple`, including the shared effect runtime.
